# Skill: Data Provenance

Every number shown by STEN, P&L, Dashboard, Budget or Finances must be traceable.

Minimum provenance:
source document/report id, source type, period, scope, extraction method, confidence/status, and calculation formula/version where derived.

UI should allow "Откуда цифра?" and show source evidence.
For imported files preserve original source; normalized Excel is a derived artifact, not the original.
Never overwrite source evidence silently.
